formal_source.scope: Integrated source verifier passed 9,168 build jobs, 301 consumer/axiom reports, 111 paper-linked declarations, and 37 terminal declarations. Actual same-witness parameter/order and column bindings are checked; full manuscript correspondence and the new release remain open.

selected_paper.review_surface: Author proofs remain visible. The selected projective rows are proposed as tangential coordinates, so the tilted minor becomes the identity and the correction coefficients are constants; all changes remain marked for review.

challenge_owners_and_consumers.statement_comparisons: Both main and fixed-source Challenge/Solution comparisons passed Palomar at the earlier post-coordinate source checkpoint; new-release comparisons remain required.
challenge_owners_and_consumers.placeholder_boundary: Challenge modules state the compared problems. Solution modules do not import challenge proof placeholders.

terminal_proof_route.role: A symplectic coordinate change makes the source Bernstein-monic.
Euler surjectivity and a filtered-page length argument exclude support over the coordinate hyperplane; involutivity supplies the characteristic-variety constraint.
Quotient vanishing yields the ordered right-sided certificate and its exact-degree fixed-source strengthening.

checked_geometric_route.mechanism: One retained valuation witness supplies the normalized projective column and residue derivation frame. The same witness supports the Kähler tangent-rank bound, quotient-rule derivative columns, and the conormal covector with the required residue.
checked_geometric_route.consumer: The component-conormal and coisotropic-exclusion modules use this endpoint in the terminal support argument.

canonical_owners.scope: The registry records reviewed canonical owners, aliases, and checked transports; it is not an exhaustive claim that all semantic duplication is gone.

open_paper_correspondence.printed_route: The preserved proof passes from a divisor on the normalized projective closure to a smooth closed point, the divisor parameter and selected projective rows as local coordinates, and a tilted arc with constant correction, primitive tangent lattice and conormal limit.
remaining_bridges: Construct the actual formally etale divisor-coordinate map from the fixed normalization center, specified parameter and selected residue rows.
Use that same map and the retained coordinate orders to construct the smooth closed ground point and its canonical completed chart.
Assemble the same completed chart, one product-avoiding tilt and actual common-open columns into the tangent-lattice input; derive its closure and smoothness fields.
Export the affine conormal closure and make this paper route carry the terminal coisotropic exclusion, without the alternative Laurent-axis producer.
open_paper_correspondence.helper_scope: The actual selected residue basis gives a height-one normalization center. Its local ring is identified with the retained valuation ring inside the same component field; one numerator realizes the specified parameter and both coordinate orders. The actual normalized projective column is identified across the point-local and common-open maps. Canonical completion and derivative commutation, selected-coordinate local calculations, and the conditional affine/projective tangent-limit consumers are checked. Their unconditional same-point assembly remains open.
open_paper_correspondence.non_claim: The checked generic-divisor matrix route reaches the same projective-direction endpoint, but does not by itself prove these correspondences with the printed normalized-divisor and closed-point construction.
